usedFor: Cakemail knows who got which campaign and tag, HubSpot keeps the sales record, and “New Contact” can feed “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Tagged” in Cakemail, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A tag is a deliberate signal, and the action changes the matching HubSpot contact when it fires.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in HubSpot finds the contact by its email, so the person has to exist in HubSpot already.
